example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এখন অন্ধ নাচারের মতো অসহায় হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is now as helpless as a blind beggar.
Help the blind beggar in the village.
history: Refers to traditional blind beggars wandering in rural Bengal, evoking cultural norms of almsgiving.
